products.name: Draft Availability Publisher
products.product: A focused brewery tap list availability tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent craft breweries operating one or more taprooms
products.problem: A keg kicks, line is taken down, release changes, or product goes on hold, but POS, menu board, website, server knowledge, and later reactivation can show different states.
products.valueProposition: Turns brewery tap list availability tracking into a visible operating queue so every draft availability change is approved, published across intended channels, verified live, and reactivated only from confirmed product and line readiness.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets brewery tap list software, beer availability tracker, taproom POS sold out, and digital tap list management searches.
